prior_source_overlap.france_study_name: Eurasian griffon vulture in France (Grands Causses 2018) ID_PROG 961
prior_source_overlap.interpretation: Distinct literal source names and bird IDs; not proof of independent biological experiments or sensors.

derived_validation_from_existing_immutab.note: All derived summaries from existing frozen GitHub artifact JSON; no raw GPS height refitting, no outcome-guided sample changes, 4000 bird-bootstrap draws descriptive.

scientific_boundary.supports: Distinctly named French wild Gyps observational cohort, same native GPS fixes under GPS-MSL and barometric height fields, repeats biologically indexed altitude-use probability shape in 27 birds at 5km, both sensors null/Holm positive.
does_not_support: Physical independence of GPS and barometric altitude: barometric height can be derived or calibrated from GPS in the same tag.
The vertical flight profile is independent of bird-tag aliasing, fine within-cell path, repeated roost terrain, or background atmosphere.
The whole source has 30 biological birds: 1 source label is a geodesy test, and only 28 birds pass frozen 5km horizontal gate.
Individual-specific environmental Wstar/wind reaction, causal atmospheric mechanism or selection/adaptive niche.
Sensor score correlation r=0.984 is independent proof of two biological replication cohorts; both height fields are on the SAME target fixes.
scientific_boundary.next: Predeclare a *new exploratory negative control* in same cohort: motion-negative low-speed GPS altitude identity at the same source 5km grain. If stationary/low-motion profiles show comparable identity signal, tag/roost location ambiguity increases. Do not revise already reported flight-height endpoint.
